summary: Sound Point Meridian Capital filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting management's unaudited estimate of its common stock net asset value per share as of August 31, 2026, in a range of $9.52 to $9.62. The filing was signed by Chief Executive Officer Ujjaval Desai and dated September 8, 2026. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine periodic NAV estimate by a listed closed-end fund, not a special situation. Watch for monthly NAV updates and any subsequent strategic announcements.
